author: 3owj
content: Added INVARIANT_FAILED_MARKER constant to workspace.rs. run_teardown writes the marker when invariant suite fails; clears it when teardown passes invariants. recover --resume checks for the marker: if present, clears it and re-launches AI (so Claude can run csnotes check, fix violations, and re-exit) rather than looping on teardown. Normal crash-mid-teardown path (no marker) unchanged.
